item.title: Road Trips Opening Reception at Archway Gallery
item.description:
Saturday, August 1, 2026 at 5 PM

Location: Archway Gallery, 2305 Dunlavy St, Houston, TX, 77006, United States

Now celebrating its fiftieth year, the member-owned Montrose gallery hosts a free opening reception for Road Trips, an exhibit featuring new paintings by Lisette McClung. This exhibit brings together a collection of both plein air and studio works—large and small—inspired by her many road trips over the past decade. Plein air—French for “open air”—refers to the practice of painting outdoors on location. As a dedicated plein air painter, McClung has been invited to paint, explore, and photograph on a variety of working ranches, as well as in fields, cities, and villages across the United States and Europe. There will be an artist talk at 6:30pm. Complimentary valet parking and light refreshments available. The exhibit will be on display from Saturday, August 1 through Thursday, September 3, 2026. Opened in 1976, Archway Gallery is currently celebrating its fiftieth year. Admission Free. Learn more. If you visit Archway Gallery’s website before the exhibition opens, be sure to click on “Exhibitions” in the top menu bar, then on “Upcoming Exhibitions”, to find details on this exhibit. “Running Wild” by Lisette McClung | Photos courtesy of Archway Gallery This Featured Calendar Listing was sponsored by the event organizer and boosted in our calendar with images and more details.
